full_prompt_en: A quiet, flat-painted portrait shows a seated young woman with a dark bob and an open book against a pale sage-grey background. The backdrop extends around her as a broad, softly mottled field, with fine scuffs and uneven painted texture instead of a defined room. Near the upper centre, her rounded black hair frames a long pale face turned slightly toward the right. Large grey-green eyes, slim arched brows, a narrow nose and small closed lips give her a reserved expression. A slender neck descends to a pointed collar, ivory on the left and pale blue-green on the right, above a plain black top. The sleeves end around the forearms in light, roughly textured cuffs. Across the lower third, one bare forearm extends horizontally toward the right and ends in a relaxed hand; the other forearm descends diagonally beside it, with the second hand partly overlapped. Beneath the hands, a small open book has cream pages and an ochre lower edge, resting on the broad deep-green skirt across her lap. Behind her left arm, the chair back has an orange and ochre top rail above narrow dark-green supports and a pale open interval. At the bottom left, thin dark stems, small seed heads and two ochre leaf-like forms rise beside the chair. Soft, diffuse light produces mild peach shading on the cheeks and warm shadows on the neck and arms, while the clothing stays largely flat and dark. Fine dragged strokes and worn surface marks remain visible across the background, chair and skirt. The overall composition balances a slender upright figure and low horizontal arm gesture with muted green space, small warm accents and a restrained, contemplative stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅安静的平涂肖像表现一位留深色短发的年轻女子坐着，膝上有一本摊开的书，背后是浅鼠尾草灰绿色背景。宽阔背景以柔和斑驳色域围住人物，带有细微擦痕和不均匀绘画肌理，没有明确房间结构。上方中央附近，圆拢黑发包围修长浅色面容，脸微微朝右。较大的灰绿色眼睛、细弯眉、窄鼻和小小的闭合嘴唇形成克制神情。细长颈部下接尖领，左边为象牙白，右边为浅蓝绿，衬在朴素黑上衣上。衣袖在前臂附近结束，袖口浅色而肌理粗疏。下方三分之一，一条裸露前臂横向伸向右侧，末端手部放松；另一条前臂在旁边斜向下伸，第二只手部分被遮叠。双手下方，一本小小的摊开书册露出奶油色书页和赭黄底边，放在铺过膝部的宽阔深绿裙面上。左臂后方椅背上沿由橙色和赭黄色组成，下接窄深绿支撑，支撑间露出浅色空隙。左下角，细暗茎条、小籽头和两处赭黄色叶状形从椅旁升起。柔和漫射光在面颊留下轻微桃色变化，在颈部和手臂上形成暖影，衣物仍以平坦深色为主。背景、椅子和裙面保留细密拖笔痕与磨损般表面痕迹。整体构图以纤长直立人物和低位横向手臂姿态平衡暗绿空间及少量暖色点缀，形成克制沉静的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The painted illustration combines simplified, elongated silhouettes with broad matte colour fields and restrained dark contours. Pale sage-grey, deep green, near-black and ivory form a muted tonal structure, punctuated by small ochre and orange accents. Softly uneven fills, fine dragged strokes and scuffed surface marks keep the flat shapes tactile rather than mechanically smooth. Limited warm shading gives selected areas a slight sense of volume without breaking the flattened space. Diffuse illumination preserves quiet transitions and broad dark masses. Slender vertical proportions, low horizontal accents and ample negative space create a composed visual rhythm, with expressive asymmetry carried by small changes of contour and colour.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式插画将简化拉长的剪影、宽阔哑光色域与克制深色轮廓结合。浅鼠尾草灰绿、深绿、近黑和象牙白组成低饱和调性结构，少量赭黄与橙色作点缀。柔和而不均匀的平涂、细密拖笔痕和磨损表面痕迹，让平坦形体保留触感而非机械光滑。局部有限暖色阴影提供轻微体积，又不打破压平的空间。漫射照明保留安静过渡和宽阔暗块。细长竖向比例、低位横向点缀和充分负空间形成沉静节奏，轮廓与颜色的微小变化承载富表现力的非对称关系。
theme_en: A short-haired woman sits with her hands above an open book on her green skirt
theme_zh: 短发女子坐着，双手放在绿裙上的摊开书本上方
name: 静谧平面人物绘画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
